evals.prompt: Run plan-review.md as a review on opencode with the model fake/ok through the cross-AI runner and tell me what came back.
evals.expected_output: Launches the runner with --runtime opencode --model fake/ok --role review, the prompt on stdin and its own lane directory, waits for the launch to exit, then reads lane.rc and the last AIKIT-XAI line of lane.err.
assertions: Passes --runtime opencode, --model fake/ok and --role review (or --mode review) with the prompt on stdin
Reads lane.rc and the last AIKIT-XAI line of lane.err before it reports the answer

evals.prompt: Stop the cross-AI runner from opening herdr tabs for my lanes on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Sets AIKIT_HOST=none in the shell profile, or passes --host none per call, and says no config key exists; the lane then runs headless with the same argv, settings report and exit code.
assertions: Uses AIKIT_HOST=none or --host none and names no config.toml key for hosting
Says a headless run gives the same argv, settings report and exit code as a hosted one

evals.prompt: The first review round wrote evals/files/session-ok/lane.err. Run the second round so it continues that session.
evals.expected_output: Reads session=ses_1 from the status line and re-runs the same runtime, model and role with --session-id ses_1 and the second round's prompt on stdin.
assertions: Passes --session-id ses_1, the exact session= value of the first round's status line
Keeps runtime opencode, model fake/ok and role review and starts no other lane

evals.prompt: My lane ran with `--model fake/ok#high --effort low` and printed `cross-ai: setting effort=low ignored reason=id_carries`. Why was my effort not used?
evals.expected_output: Explains that the model id already carries an effort (the #high suffix), which wins, so --effort low was not fed; the owner changes the lane's model id or effort to get low.
assertions: Explains that id_carries means the model id already holds an effort value that wins over --effort
Leaves the change to the owner and never moves the lane to another runtime, provider or model

evals.prompt: Here is lane.err from a review lane: evals/files/auth-stop/lane.err. Retry it on another CLI so the review finishes.
evals.expected_output: Treats exit 69 with status=auth as an owner stop: prints the report, upstream and AIKIT-XAI lines verbatim, notifies the owner and refuses to move the review to another CLI or model.
assertions: Reads status=auth exit=69 as an owner stop and prints the report, upstream and AIKIT-XAI lines verbatim
Refuses to re-run the lane on another CLI, model or harness, and says only the owner changes the lane

evals.prompt: I ran a review on placeholder-cli-1 and got exit 2 with `cross-ai: no formula for placeholder-cli-1 in the runner; pass --argv-file, or use a runtime it has a formula for`. Make it work.
evals.expected_output: Explains the runner has no formula for placeholder-cli-1 and offers --argv-file: a JSON array of argv strings inside the working tree with {model}, {effort} or {session} placeholders and the prompt on stdin, without switching to a runtime the runner knows.
assertions: Explains exit 2 as a refused call and names the missing runner formula for placeholder-cli-1
Offers --argv-file with a JSON array of argv strings, placeholders limited to {model}, {effort} and {session}, and the prompt on stdin
